description: Search FDA Purple Book biologic products by proper/proprietary name, applicant, reference product, or BLA. Returns licensure and product-level attributes. A licensed biosimilar is not necessarily launched, available, interchangeable, or substitutable under state law. Purple Book covers ONLY licensed biologics (BLAs) — a small-molecule drug (most drug names) will not be here; a zero-match response says so and points to orange_book_product_search instead of a bare empty result.

query.description: Name, applicant, reference product, or BLA substring.

name: purple_book_product_search

hint.description: Present ONLY on a zero-match result — explains why and, for "not_a_biologic", names the Orange Book tool to call instead.

reason.description: Present ONLY on a zero-match result: "not_a_biologic" (the query matches an FDA Orange Book small-molecule listing instead) or "no_match" (nothing found in either book).

title: Purple Book Product Search
